name: idle
notes: Loops on itself: frame `frames` would be frame 0.
Its frame 0 is the ADVANCE's first and last frame (by station), so IDLE -> ADVANCE -> IDLE never pops.
figures: one per station, left to right (rappeller, flag-planter, ledge-sitter, window-hiker, handstand, lookout); tint = the station's index.

After an ADVANCE each station holds the hiker from the station behind it, so in a one-color-per-hiker colorway every station's tint is one less (mod 6) than before: keep a running offset and draw tint (station + offset) mod 6, offset decreasing by one per ADVANCE.
units: logo units: capital height 100, baseline y = 0, y down (the wordmark's own coordinates: rig.json, wordmark-*.svg)
angles: degrees, absolute, in (-180, 180], 0 = right, clockwise +, from a bone's parent joint to its child joint (_n near side, _f far side; every hiker faces right)

head.note: a filled circle whose center is that far from the chest along the head's angle

skeleton.sides: _n is the side nearer the viewer, _f the far side; a hiker facing left is the same skeleton mirrored in x
skeleton.caps: every bone is a stroke with round caps and round joins; lengths never change
skeleton.far_side_color: the shade; the near arm also carries a 0.75-unit rim of the shade so it reads across the body

knockout.note: in front of a letter, every part is first drawn that much larger in the ground color

pack.note: a rounded rectangle on the back of the torso, turned with it

skeleton.scale: all lengths and widths times a figure's scale (1 in the wordmark, 1.15 in the icon)

draw.order: per hiker, back to front: leg_f, arm_f, pack, torso, leg_n, head, binoculars, arm_n (arm_n with a rim in the shade color 1.5 wider under it); far limbs in the shade color

layers.order: back to front: hikers on the behind layer, the letters, then every other hiker and every prop
layers.ink: a letter's ink is its centerline stroked at its stroke width with round caps and round joins; its hull is that ink plus its closed counters
layers.behind: a hiker on the behind layer is hidden by ink and seen through counters and past the letters' edges, unless clip names one counter (the P's window), which hides everything outside it; anything behind that drops below the baseline (y > 0) is gone
layers.per_part: a part listed in parts_in_front is drawn on the front layer while the rest stays behind
layers.the_fall: the lookout on the last e tips over and moves to the behind layer: seen through the e's eye on the way down, gone below the baseline

knockout.how: the stills paint the widened outline in the ground color; on any other backdrop make it a mask that cuts the widened outline out of the letters and of hikers further back

flag.note: filled and stroked in the flag color, round joins

draw.front: every front item (props first, then hikers in order) has a knockout: its outline widened by knockout.width, cut out of everything drawn before it
